// Prepare notification texts for WhatsApp & Email const lead = $json.body; const waMessage = `🚨 *[NEW HOT LEAD DETECTED]*\n\n` + `🏢 *Company:* ${lead.company_name}\n` + `📍 *Area:* ${lead.area || 'Pune MIDC'}\n` + `★ *Score:* ${lead.score}/100 (${lead.priority} Priority)\n` + `🎯 *Decision Maker:* ${lead.decision_maker || 'Head of IT / Operations'}\n` + `📞 *Phone:* ${lead.phone || 'Available on Google Maps'}\n` + `🌐 *Website:* ${lead.website || 'N/A'}\n` + `⚙️ *Tech Stack:* ${lead.tech_stack || 'Industrial Manufacturing'}\n\n` + `💬 *Proposed Pitch:*\n${lead.whatsapp_pitch || lead.email_pitch || ''}`; const emailSubject = `🚨 [Lead Alert] ${lead.company_name} in ${lead.area || 'Pune'} (Score: ${lead.score}/100)`; const emailHtml = `
🎯 Autonomous Lead Intelligence: ${lead.company_name}

Industrial Corridor: ${lead.area || 'Pune MIDC'}

Relevance Score: ${lead.score}/100 (${lead.priority} Priority)

Target Persona: ${lead.decision_maker || 'Head of IT / Operations'}

Contact Phone: ${lead.phone || 'N/A'}

Website: ${lead.website || 'N/A'}

Tech Stack: ${lead.tech_stack || 'N/A'}

Generated Outreach Pitch:

${lead.email_pitch || lead.whatsapp_pitch || ''}

`; return { lead_id: lead.id, company_name: lead.company_name, score: lead.score, priority: lead.priority, whatsapp_message: waMessage, email_subject: emailSubject, email_html: emailHtml, status: "ready_for_dispatch" };
